purpose: Use result-independent IID white fields to decide whether the exact legacy N576-to-N192 output-Nyquist handling causes the V8 high-shell power deficit, and whether a deterministic variance-preserving +/- Nyquist fold repairs that numerical mechanism.

legacy_projection.policy: The first full-size control field must be projected by both the production callable and the precomputed-rFFT helper; the two float32 spatial results must agree at the frozen normalized-error tolerances.

sampling.distribution: independent standard normal in N576 spatial cells
sampling.streaming_policy: One source and its two N192 projections at a time; retain only scalar shell metrics.

shells.mask: Exact cubical F192 minus F64 rFFT mask used by the sealed V8 audit.

regions.interior: No component lies on the N192 output-Nyquist index.
regions.boundary: At least one of kx, ky, kz lies on the N192 output-Nyquist index.

comparison.comparison_scope: Only shells with nonzero output-Nyquist boundary weight enter the legacy-to-V8 mechanism gate.

all_required: The legacy helper reproduces the production callable.
Legacy non-Nyquist interiors remain statistically white.
The variance-preserving fold is statistically white in every released shell and on every affected Nyquist boundary subset.
The legacy boundary has a material power deficit.
The legacy white-field shell means match the sealed V8 means on all boundary-affected shells.
The variance-preserving fold is closer to unit power than legacy on every boundary-affected shell.

decision.pass: Isolate the numerical high-shell failure to output-Nyquist handling and authorize a separately frozen future-only projection contract. This does not repair the independent CF4 posterior-family failure and does not authorize V9, seed promotion, or RAMSES.
decision.fail: Do not alter projection. Expand the numerical control before designing any new constrained-realization architecture.

storage.write_policy: exclusive create; lifecycle and output files are immutable
